facts.text: The hotel is in central Tokyo, close to government offices, embassies and major companies.
facts.excerpt: The ANA InterContinental Tokyo, in central Tokyo, is ideal for business with its proximity to government offices, embassies, and major companies.

facts.text: The hotel is located in the Ark Hills complex, which includes a classic concert hall.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located in Ark Hills which was built 20 years ago, and it was the first big complex in Tokyo. It includes the hotel, a classic concert hall and a business centre.

facts.text: Roppongi, an area bustling with restaurants, bars and cafes, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A 10 minute walk from the hotel, discover this area bustling with restaurants, bars and cafes.

facts.text: Suntory Hall is two minutes from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Suntory Hall is two minutes away, which makes this the obvious choice on a concert night.

facts.text: Guest rooms offer views of Tokyo Tower, the Imperial Palace Gardens or Roppongi.
facts.excerpt: Offering views of Tokyo Tower, the Imperial Palace Gardens, or vibrant Roppongi

facts.text: Rooms have designs inspired by the Japanese art of Kintsugi.

facts.text: The lobby has soaring double-height ceilings gridded with geometric lights, warm wood paneling and a glowing staircase.

facts.excerpt: Overlooking the manicured perfection of a traditional garden and pond designed to highlight each season's beauty, Unkai showcases seasonal specialties and the essence of Japanese cuisine.

facts.text: Teppanyaki Akasaka on the 37th floor has views over Tokyo.

facts.text: MIXX Bar and Lounge on the 36th floor overlooks the Tokyo metropolis.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the dramatic Tokyo metropolis, MIXX Bar and Lounge transforms each evening into a sophisticated meeting place perfect with friends or colleagues.

facts.text: Main Bar Da Vinci offers over 200 whiskies and live nightly entertainment.
facts.excerpt: Choose from over 200 whiskies sourced from boutique and rare distilleries, as well as a global selection of liqueurs, cocktails, and imported cigars. Relax in style and enjoy the intimate atmosphere and live nightly entertainment.

facts.text: Family suites sleep four with the sofa bed and can be booked without lounge access.
